violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
Various food was observed stored on the floor in the walk-in cooler. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Knives were observed being stored on an unclean surface at the sushi bar between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. All knives were moved to ware washing area at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

3 door lowboy #1 was observed holding an ambient temperature of 43 DF. Establishment is not to store any TCS foods in 3 door lowboy unit until it is able to hold an ambient temperature of 41 DF or less. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. -Walk-in shelves -Prep unit shelves -Ice machine -Storage containers Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The 1 door reach-in freezer was observed with an accumulation of ice build-up. Establishment is to remove ice/run a defrost on unit. New Violation. Correct By: 07/10/2026

The oil bin outside is located on dirt/grass. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
The outside oil bin was observed with an accumulation of debris. Outside refuse areas must be maintained. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The following areas have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. -Bar storage area -Kitchen storage area -Floor by the cook line The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

Several floor tiles in the kitchen, the floor to the walk-in freezer, and the door threshold to the walk-in cooler were observed to be cracked/chipped/worn and in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/31/2026
